svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Sinusoidal positional encoding
svg.desc: A grid of positions by embedding dimensions, coloured by the value of sine or cosine. Low dimensions oscillate quickly with position and high dimensions oscillate slowly, so every position gets a unique pattern, like the digits of a number.
svg.text: Each position gets a unique pattern, like a binary counter made of waves.
